svg.title: Half-frame pair with Film Edge: one engine canvas

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Half-frame pair with Film Edge

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One strip, rendered by the engine: the same gate exposed twice, 19.00 mm apart. Frames 6 and 6A, Kodak Gold 200 on Supra Endura, camera No. 19.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Engine render (scratch build: mobile 371ad16 + pair_scratch.patch). Nothing drawn by hand.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top band: 6, then the stock name. Bottom band: the DX code twice (one per half frame), 6, then 6A with its arrow.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Why one canvas, not two renders butted together:

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • each render has its own scan rotation and weave, so the

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: strip's edges and perforations would step at the seam;

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • the numbers walk in half-frame steps across one canvas

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (6 then 6A); two seeds can only land whole frames apart;

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • halation, edge fog and leaks cross the gap, as on film.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The camera exposes one gate twice, so the kernel's gate

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is the union of the gate and the same gate one advance on:

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the corners, wobble and penumbra repeat exactly.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measured on this render: each gate 1,615 × 2,148 px (the

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1,600 × 2,133 picture and its penumbra); the gap 75 px,

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 0.84 mm (the 1 mm between frames, less the soft edges).

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Exposure scope on the strip: the right hole's print +1.00

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Frame: only the right picture

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: + Overscan: the rebate, edge print and gap with it

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The negative is the same in both: a print-only change.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: So each region is a reprint of one developed canvas

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (a reprint, not a re-develop), cut together along the

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: engine's own gate coverage. Left gate, right gate, overscan:

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: three regions, each with its own print. That is how

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: every hole keeps its own print and paper on one strip.

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: With Film Edge the scope is plainly visible; without it,

text.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the gap alone sits near paper black and barely moves.
